title: Wren and the Border
author: Sebastian Galloway
blurb: Dominic Ashgrove, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
